Product_Name: Whynter Portable Air Conditioner 14,000 BTU with Dual Hose Dehumidifier & Cooling Fan for 500 Sq Ft Rooms, Includes AC Unit Window Kit, ARC-14S (9,500 BTU SACC)
Ai_text: Customers are happy with the performance and ease of installation of the air conditioner. They mention that it works well, it fires up flawlessly and that it is easy to setup. Descrizione:
Achieve optimal comfort with the multi-award-winning ARC-14S Whynter Portable Air Conditioner (14,000 BTU / 9,500 BTU SACC). The ideal free-standing air conditioner for rooms up to 500 square feet., this versatile floor AC unit cools, dehumidifies, and circulates indoor air effectively. This stand-alone air conditioner comes equipped with an activated carbon filter and washable pre-filter designed to provide superior air quality. The ultimate AC unit for home use, this standing AC features a sleek platinum/black design. This powerful yet quiet air conditioner also boasts a dual hose system designed to maximize cooling power while blending seamlessly into any space. Crowned the 2024 Best Overall by Good Housekeeping, the 2024 TIME Stamped: Best Technological Portable AC, and awarded by trusted sources like USA Today and The New York Post. Trust Whynter, an environmentally conscious US-based brand since 2006, 
to deliver high-efficiency portable air conditioning for your home.
